title: Macros (q, @)
instruction_text:
Record and replay sequences of commands!

'q' followed by a letter = start recording to that register
'q' again = stop recording
'@' followed by letter = replay the macro
'@@' = replay last macro

Your task: Use a macro to add 'Item: ' before each number.

Steps:
1. Move to '1'
2. Press 'qa' (start recording to register 'a')
3. Press 'I' (insert at beginning of line)
4. Type 'Item: '
5. Press ESC
6. Press 'j' (move to next line)
7. Press 'q' (stop recording)
8. Press '3@a' (replay macro 3 times for remaining lines)
9. Save with :wq

Macros are powerful for repetitive tasks!
